description: Creates an email autoresponder on a connection. A gated write on another account: it starts emailing the customer's prospects, so wait for the human's yes (on another account there may be no 409 warning). Every lead through the connection receives every autoresponder on it; a 409 lists what is already attached, ask the human before acknowledging.

account_id.description: Admin keys only: the LeadSync account (user id, integer or digit string) to act on; overrides LEADSYNC_ACCOUNT

acknowledge_shared_connection.description: Set true only after the human has seen the existing autoresponders from a 409 and agreed they will stack

content.description: Plain text (blank-line paragraphs become paragraphs) or HTML per content_format. Tokens like #first_name pass through

override_limits.description: Admin keys with write access only: skip plan and quantity limits, never the shared-connection guard

name: create_autoresponder
